AddressableAreaLocation.description: The location of something placed in an addressable area. This is a superset of deck slots.

addressableAreaName.description: The id of an addressable area from the deck definition.

DeckSlotLocation.description: The location of something placed in a single deck slot.

slotName.description: A slot on the robot deck. OT-2 uses plain numbers; Flex uses coordinates like C2.

InStackerHopperLocation.description: The location of labware stored in a Flex Stacker hopper.

moduleId.description: The ID of the stacker module containing this labware.

ModuleLocation.description: The location of something placed atop a hardware module.

moduleId.description: The ID of a loaded module.

OnLabwareLocation.description: The location of something placed atop another labware.

labwareId.description: The ID of the labware this item is stacked on.

LoadedLabwareLocation.description: Where loaded labware is located. Matches shared-data/command LoadedLabwareLocation.

$otSharedSchema.description: The path to a valid OpentronsAI intermediate representation schema relative to the shared-data directory, without its extension.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version of the intermediate representation output is a single integer

metadata.description: Metadata about the intermediate representation to generate a protocol

name.description: A short, human-readable name for the protocol

author.description: The author or organization who created the protocol

description.description: A text description of the protocol.

created.description: UNIX timestamp when this file was created

lastModified.description: UNIX timestamp when this file was last modified

model.description: Model of the robot this protocol is written for

deckId.description: Identifier of physical deck this protocol is written for. This should match a definition in the shared-data deck directory.

labwareDefinitionSchemaId.description: The schema to use for labware definitions.

customLabwareDefinitions.description: All custom labware definitions used by labware in this protocol, keyed by labwareDefURI

liquidSchemaId.description: The schema to use for liquid definitions.

liquids.description: All liquids used in this protocol, keyed by a unique identifier (liquidId)

liquidGroupId.description: Liquid id used to identify the liquid group

displayColor.description: The display color of the liquid in hexcode

liquidClass.description: Optional liquid class name assigned to the liquid.

ingredLocations.description: All instances of where liquids and their amounts are located at the start of the protocol, keyed by labwareId

pipettes.description: Pipettes needed in the protocol, keyed by pipette id

name.description: The pipette name of the pipette

mount.description: The mount on which the pipette is located

tiprackDefURIs.description: The tiprackDefURIs that the pipette uses

labware.description: Labware needed in the protocol, keyed by labware id

labwareDefURI.description: The labwareDefURI needed to properly identify the labware via its loadName, namespace and version

stackedOnNode.description: Where this labware is located on the deck, on another labware, in a module, or in a stacker hopper.

modules.description: Modules needed in the protocol, keyed by module id

location.description: Deck slot or addressable area where the module is located

wasteChuteLocation.description: The location of a waste chute if it exists in the protocol

trashBinLocations.description: The locations of the trash bins in the protocol

stagingAreaLocations.description: The locations of staging area slots in the protocol

commandSchemaId.description: The schema to which the commands adhere.

commands.description: An array of command objects representing steps to be executed on the robot.
